evals.name: confirmation gate fires before any search

evals.expected_output: A search brief table with a Source column built from the resume, followed by at most about 5 numbered questions in one message that ask for work mode, base pay floor and visa sponsorship. No job-board request is made before the user answers.

Asks for work mode, base pay floor, and visa sponsorship
Asks at most about 5 questions, all in one message

evals.name: remote only, US — non-US remote removed, Americas flagged, employer links
evals.prompt:
Here's my resume (attached). Remote only, and the remote job has to be open to people in the US. No pay floor. I don't need visa sponsorship. Exclude Lumenly. Everything else, use your best read of the resume and go straight to the search.

[Eval setup — not part of the user's message: from the skill folder, run every job-scout script with JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR=evals/files/worlds/day1 and JOB_SCOUT_HOME set to a new empty temp directory. In Phase 4 run `python3 scripts/probe.py --boards greenhouse:koboldmetals,greenhouse:arizeai,ashby:turquoise-health,ashby:reactivemarkets` instead of the default board pick.]
evals.expected_output: The brief saves work_modes [remote] and remote_scope [US], then the search runs on the four replayed boards. The Reactive Markets Senior Frontend Engineer (Remote, UK) is not in the results table; it may appear under close but excluded with a reason saying remote is limited to the UK. The Kobold Metals Frontend Software Engineer (Remote, North America), if shown, carries an Americas flag. Every link opens the job on the employer's own job page.
assertions: Runs scripts/probe.py with JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR pointing at evals/files/worlds/day1 and the four-board --boards list
Saves a profile with work_modes ["remote"] and remote_scope including "US"
The Reactive Markets 'Senior Frontend Engineer' (Remote, UK) is not a row in the results table
If the Reactive Markets job is mentioned at all, it is under close but excluded with a reason saying remote is limited to the UK (GB)
If the Kobold Metals 'Frontend Software Engineer' (Remote, North America) is shown, its row or notes carry a flag such as 'Americas — check US eligibility'

Every link in the table is an https employer job page (job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com or the employer's own site), never an aggregator (Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor and similar) and never an API address
Shows only jobs that scripts/fetch_jd.py reported as open

[Eval setup — not part of the user's message: from the skill folder, run every job-scout script with JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR=evals/files/worlds/day1 and JOB_SCOUT_HOME set to a new empty temp directory. evals.name: just go — proceeds with labelled defaults
evals.prompt: Here's my resume (attached). Skip the questions and just go — use your best guess.
evals.expected_output: The brief is still shown, with every assumed value labelled default (or inferred), and the skill proceeds in the same reply without waiting: it saves the profile and runs the network check.
assertions: Shows the brief table even though the user asked to skip questions
Every value the user did not provide is labelled default or inferred, not presented as confirmed
Does not stop to ask questions
Saves the profile with scripts/state.py profile save and runs scripts/probe.py --health in the same reply
Does not invent a pay floor or a sponsorship answer: base_pay_floor is null (no floor) and needs_sponsorship is undisclosed unless stated

evals.name: rerun — new first, changed explained, applied not new, saved role closed, failed board never closes
evals.prompt:
Anything new since last week?

[Eval setup — not part of the user's message: from the skill folder, run every job-scout script with JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR=evals/files/worlds/day2 and JOB_SCOUT_HOME set to a new temp directory. Before the conversation starts, copy evals/files/worlds/day2/profile.json into it as profile.json and evals/files/seen-after-feedback.json as seen.json (the brief the user confirmed last week and their feedback on last week's results). evals.expected_output: The saved brief is shown as same as last time and not re-asked. The applied Turquoise Health 'Senior Design Engineer' is listed as applied and still open, not as new. The saved Arize AI 'Senior Open Source Design Engineer' is listed as closed since last time. The KoBold Metals 'Frontend Software Engineer' is not called closed. The reply ends with the feedback prompt.
assertions: Runs scripts/probe.py with JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR pointing at evals/files/worlds/day2 and the four-board --boards list, then scripts/state.py seen diff and scripts/filter.py
Shows the saved brief as same as last time (at most asks whether to change anything) and does not re-ask work mode, pay floor or sponsorship before searching
The Arize AI 'Design Engineer, Design Systems' role is listed before every other role and is marked NEW
The Arize AI 'Senior AI Product Engineer, Frontend' role is marked as changed and says what changed: the title went from '..., Fullstack' to '..., Frontend'
The Turquoise Health 'Senior Design Engineer' (applied last week) is not marked NEW and not shown as a new result; if mentioned, it is under applied or still open
The Arize AI 'Senior Open Source Design Engineer' (saved last week) is listed as closed since last time
No KoBold Metals role is called closed; the KoBold Metals board is described as not checked or failed this time, not as having no jobs
Ends with a feedback prompt (save, applied, dismiss, or similar)

The questions ask for work mode, base pay floor and visa sponsorship. No job-board request is made before the user answers.

Title exclusions do not contain 'Product Manager' or a bare 'Manager'; any people-manager exclusion names titles like Director of Product, Head of Product or VP Product
